name: AquaFarm Ace V6
author: unity_9R7DPPpRQj2u5w
description:
AquaFarm Ace is a 2D time management simulation game on aquaculture where the player controls an aquaculturist-in-the-making following through the different phases of the aquaculture process, accomplishing tasks, and getting through several challenges to complete a purchase order from a customer. The gameplay features the production phases of aquaculture of the nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) starting from hatcheries, transporting, grow-out systems, market selection, and broodstock management. 

The game intends to have informative and explanatory elements to advocate the practice of aquaculture and engage players in contributing to the community of the aquatic agriculture sector.
